pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Photoroom offers a Free plan… exports are limited to 250 per month and include a watermark… Pro… $7.50 per month when you pay for a full year… Monthly billing costs $12.99/month… Max… $20.99 per month when billed annually… Monthly billing on Max costs $34.99"
